description: Why BUY from Nissan of Streetsboro?     When you choose this Serenity White 2024 Hyundai Elantra Hybrid Blue with 163,353 miles, you are not just buying a used vehicle - you are investing in quality, reliability and peace of mind. Our clientele depend on us for Transparent Pricing, Convenience and, most importantly, Customer FIRST Service!           What this vehicle includes:     Option Group 01          Convenience Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.Safety and Security Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Brake assist - Stop right there.  Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now!  With brake assist, you will.  It uses the speed of the brake pedals travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.Technology and Telematics Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. description: 1989 Porsche 911 Speedster | 68,000 Miles | 25-Year Enthusiast Ownership | California History  The 1989 Porsche 911 Speedster is one of the defining cars of the air-cooled era. Its low windshield, wide rear bodywork, and unmistakable twin-hump top cover give it a presence unlike any other classic 911. This Silver Metallic over gray leather example adds something equally important: 25 years with the same Porsche enthusiast owner, California registration history from new, extensive records, and substantial recent mechanical work.  Available at Porsche San Francisco, part of indiGO Auto Group, this Speedster shows approximately 68,000 miles. It is one of just 823 examples delivered to the United States for 1989. Behind the driver sits Porsches 3.2-liter air-cooled flat-six, paired with the desirable G50 five-speed manual transaxle. Its the mechanical, connected driving experience that makes the final 3.2-liter Carrera-era cars so sought after.  Extensive work by Porsche specialists  This Speedster has received significant attention where it matters most. Elephant Racing performed a comprehensive suspension and brake rebuild, addressing the systems at the heart of how the car steers, handles, and stops.  Additional work was performed by Gunter Feldmeier at Porsche San Francisco and is supported by service records. It includes:  New genuine Porsche replacement soft top  Replacement of the clutch assembly  Replacement of the camshafts  Replacement of fuel lines and impulse/reference sensors  Replacement of all belts and engine-compartment insulation  Major 30,000-mile maintenance service  Brake fluid exchange  Porsche Classic Vehicle Diagnostic  These are meaningful investments in the cars driving experience and continued care. Buyers are welcome to review the available records to understand the work performed.  Classic Speedster design  The Speedster combines a shortened windshield and side windows with wide rear bodywork shared with the contemporary 911 Turbo. Its fiberglass twin-hump cover conceals the folding soft top and creates the profile that made this model an instant Porsche icon. The new genuine Porsche top is a particularly valuable recent addition.  Silver Metallic paint suits the Speedsters clean lines, while 16-inch Fuchs alloy wheels complete its period-correct appearance. Other exterior details include integrated fog lights, rear bumperettes, and a single exhaust outlet.  Inside, the dedicated two-seat cabin is finished in gray, with leather power-adjustable seats that were replaced approximately 10 years ago, plus matching dashboard, door panels, and carpeting. Equipment includes a short-throw shifter, air conditioning, cruise control, and a CD-based stereo.  Ownership and documentation  The car has been California registered since new and has remained with its current Porsche enthusiast owner for 25 years. It is accompanied by a Porsche Certificate of Authenticity, owners manual, service records, car cover, clean Carfax report, and clean California title.  A 1989 Speedster is rare by production alone. What makes this one especially compelling is the combination of long-term ownership, documented California history, approximately 68,000 miles, and major recent work by Elephant Racing and Porsche San Francisco. It is a car with a story a serious buyer can examine, and a driving experience that deserves to be felt.  Contact Porsche San Francisco, part of indiGO Auto Group, to review the documentation and arrange a personal viewing.

The X6 M50i's performance focus is matched by mechanical capability that is consistent with its trim level, and the model is known for pairing strong acceleration with all-weather usability and composed road manners. Steering response, suspension tuning, and braking performance are part of the broader driving character associated with this badge, and the chassis is designed to handle both routine commuting and more assertive highway travel. The vehicle's size places it in a useful middle ground for buyers who want a larger premium model without moving into a full-size category. Its equipment list is straightforward, and the combination of comfort items, connectivity features, and safety technology gives a clear picture of what this example includes.
